scenario.name: gnss-loss
scenario.description: Complete loss of GNSS aiding while enroute. The navigation estimator must degrade gracefully to dead reckoning and the mission must continue under the declared recovery policy without affecting flight control.
scenario.document:
apiVersion: resilient-uas.dev/v1alpha1
kind: ResilienceScenario
metadata:
  name: gnss-loss
  description: Complete loss of GNSS aiding while enroute. The navigation estimator must degrade gracefully
    to dead reckoning and the mission must continue under the declared recovery policy without affecting
    flight control.
  version: '1'
  labels: {}
  tags:
  - navigation
target:
  adapter: px4-gazebo
  vehicle: x500
  configuration: {}
mission:
  type: waypoint
  timeout: 180s
  cruise_speed: 6.0
  altitude: 30.0
  waypoints: []
recovery:
  gnss_loss: dead_reckoning
  datalink_loss: continue
  compute_loss: hold
  hold_timeout: 60s
  max_dead_reckoning: 120s
simulation:
  seed: 7
  speed: 1.0
  telemetry_rate_hz: 10.0
events:
- id: gnss-loss
  at: 35s
  inject:
    subsystem: navigation.gnss
    effect: unavailable
    duration: 40s
    parameters: {}
  expect:
  - subsystem: navigation.estimator
    state: DEGRADED
    within: 3s
    description: ''
  description: ''
assertions:
- expression: flight_control.available == true
  severity: critical
  description: ''
- expression: safety.loss_of_control == false
  severity: critical
  description: ''
- expression: containment.flight_domain_affected == false
  severity: critical
  description: ''
- expression: navigation.integrity >= 0.70
  severity: medium
  description: ''
- expression: recovery.navigation_estimator < 5s
  severity: high
  description: The estimator re-acquires GNSS aiding promptly once fixes return
- expression: mission.completion >= 0.90
  severity: medium
  description: ''
scoring:
  profile: default

target.data_origin: PX4 SITL simulation (software in the loop, no hardware)

profile.name: default
profile.description: Balanced profile for autonomous flight: safety first, then mission continuity and recovery, then containment and navigation, then communications.

dimensions.label: Safety preservation
dimensions.explanation: flight control available 100.0% of the run

assertions.description: The estimator re-acquires GNSS aiding promptly once fixes return

events.message: Navigation Estimator UNKNOWN -> DEGRADED: px4 telemetry
GNSS Receiver: 'unavailable' applied via px4:param EKF2_GPS_CTRL=0

metadata.detail: EKF2_GPS_CTRL 7 -> 0: removes GPS aiding from the EKF; global position estimate is lost

events.message: GNSS Receiver NOMINAL -> UNAVAILABLE: px4 telemetry
Navigation Estimator NOMINAL -> DEGRADED: px4 telemetry
Expected Navigation Estimator DEGRADED within 3s: observed (DEGRADED)

components.name: Ground Control Station
components.description: Operator ground station issuing commands over the C2 link.

components.name: C2 Datalink
components.description: Command and control link between the ground station and the vehicle.

components.name: Telemetry Gateway
components.description: Onboard gateway forwarding telemetry to the ground and commands onboard.

components.name: Mission Computer
components.description: Companion computer hosting mission planning and autonomy services.

components.name: Mission Planner Process
components.description: Process sequencing waypoints and issuing setpoints to the flight core.

components.name: Companion Link
components.description: Onboard network link between the mission computer and the flight core.

components.name: Command Gateway
components.description: Policy enforcement point validating mission commands before they reach the flight core. Fails closed.

components.name: GNSS Receiver
components.description: Satellite positioning source used to aid the navigation estimator.

components.name: Navigation Estimator
components.description: State estimator fusing GNSS, inertial, barometric and magnetic data.

components.name: Inertial Measurement Unit
components.description: Primary attitude sensing for the flight core.

components.name: Flight Core
components.description: Flight controller running attitude and position control loops.

trust_boundaries.name: Mission / Flight-critical boundary
trust_boundaries.description: Commands from the mission computer are validated by the command gateway before reaching the flight core. The flight core keeps full control authority if everything upstream fails.

trust_boundaries.name: External / Mission boundary
trust_boundaries.description: Ground commands enter the vehicle through the telemetry gateway.
